name: Judeo-Arabic

ancestors.notes: Genetically the Judeo-Arabic varieties are regional Arabic dialects (spoken Judeo-Arabic tracks the local Arabic vernacular closely); Standard/Classical Arabic is kept as the macro-level genetic anchor, per the ar-x-maghrebi.json precedent.
Hebrew (and Aramaic) adstrate: shared liturgical/literary register, Hebrew-script orthography, and a Hebrew-Aramaic lexical stratum common across Judeo-Arabic varieties (Wikipedia: Judeo-Arabic).

notes:
STUB / MACRO NODE. Judeo-Arabic (ISO 639-3 macrolanguage jrb) is the collective code for the range of Arabic varieties historically spoken and written by Jewish communities across the Arab world, traditionally in HEBREW SCRIPT (rather than Arabic script) and carrying a Hebrew/Aramaic lexical and liturgical adstrate. As a macrolanguage code it is a sociolinguistic/orthographic collective, not a single genetic node: each individual variety (aju Judeo-Moroccan, ajt Judeo-Tunisian, yhd Judeo-Iraqi, and others such as Judeo-Egyptian, Judeo-Yemeni, Judeo-Tripolitanian Arabic) is genetically just the local regional Arabic dialect with a Hebrew-script/Hebrew-adstrate literary tradition overlaid. This node exists so those varieties (aju.json, ajt.json, yhd.json) have a macro-level parent to resolve to, per the graph-connectivity rule; it carries no phonology of its own (graphemes/allophones empty) because there is no single Judeo-Arabic phonology to state — each individual language's own spec is the level at which sourced grapheme mappings belong.

RESOLVES TO ITS PARENT'S TABLE, WHICH IS A PLACEHOLDER. This spec declared a parent and no `graphemes_base`, so it produced no phonology at all and the code resolved to an empty table — a caller asking for it got nothing, silently. It now inherits, so the code reaches a usable table. That table is the parent's and is NOT a claim about this variety: no reflex here has been checked against a source. `quality` stays `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's. The parent it already named, arb, is the one it now inherits from.
